scenarios.title: Discover a seller's verified AdCP endpoint from its public listing
scenarios.description: Fetch the public seller page, follow the machine-readable listing link, confirm the card identity matches the named seller, and select the verified `adcp` action URL byte-for-byte.
scenarios.mutationBoundary: Read-only against the public listing and the seller's own AdCP endpoint. Never mutates Interchange state; any resulting media buy is a real transaction on the seller's endpoint, not a sandbox fixture.

scenarios.title: Stop when the publication does not advertise a direct buying endpoint
scenarios.description: When the listing carries no verified `adcp` action, report that this publication does not currently advertise a direct buying endpoint rather than inventing `/mcp`, `/mcp/v3`, or a Seller ID.
scenarios.mutationBoundary: Read-only; the scenario terminates before any endpoint connection is attempted.
